mcqs.question: How many medals did India win at the Asian U15 Boxing Championships held in Tashkent, Uzbekistan?
mcqs.explanation: India won 27 medals at the Asian U15 Boxing Championships: 9 gold, 6 silver and 12 bronze. The figures 14 and 13 refer to the medal tallies of the U15 girls’ and boys’ teams respectively, while 9 is only the number of gold medals won by India.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly identifies the location of the 22nd Commonwealth Table Tennis Championships 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The 22nd Commonwealth Table Tennis Championships 2026 will be held at Thyagaraj Stadium in New Delhi from 27 July to 2 August 2026. Lausanne is the location of the ITTF headquarters, while Tashkent, Uzbekistan is associated with the Asian U15 Boxing Championships.
